text: Namaste! Main samajh sakta hoon ki aapko is problem ki wajah se pareshani hui hai. Maine aapki yeh baat human support team ko transfer kar di hai, kyunki sealed box mein item miss hone ka case manually investigate karna padega. Ek expert agent jald hi aapse baat karega aur iska samadhan karega. Thoda sa intezaar karein, dhanyawad!
